latest_release.name: VIVI-GITHUB-DROID v7.0.1
latest_release.body:
## Hotfix

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed HTTP 403 Forbidden errors and premature stream cutoffs on YouTube CDN for free and logged-in accounts
- Fixed BotGuard PoToken generation for authenticated web client playback sessions
- Added dynamic stream client failure tracking and graceful recovery in MusicService to eliminate 403 retry loops

### Optimizations
- Significantly improved lyrics loading speed and eliminated provider timeout delays
- Upgraded InnerTubeX to v0.11.6 for enhanced stream extraction, cipher decoding, and networking stability

### Improvements
- Restored default font for song title and artist names in Player V2 and Player V2 Landscape
- Removed Listen Together option from player menus and made connected users count in Player V2 a read-only badge
- Added dual-mode stream extraction: delivers 256+ kbps (itag 141) audio for YouTube Premium subscribers while automatically using standard mobile streaming for ordinary accounts
